description: This file defines the EmpDependentDecorator class, which provides additional functionality and convenience methods for the EmpDependent entity within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for handling dependent data such as date of birth, relationship, and associating with employee records.

classes.name: EmpDependentDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class that adds utility methods on top of the EmpDependent entity, such as date formatting, relationship description, and linking to Employee entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmpDependent entity.

methods.name: getDateOfBirth
methods.description: Returns the formatted date of birth of the dependent, or null if not available.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with the dependent by employee number.

methods.name: getRelationship
methods.description: Returns the relationship type as a string, capitalized, handling 'Other' relationship types specially.
